subject: Neighborhood Ambassador Task Force
overview: Host John Petrella interviewed North Medford Ambassador Nate Rubright about the city's Neighborhood Ambassador Task Force. Rubright discussed the program's volunteer structure, community building in North Medford, and efforts to help residents navigate municipal services.

items.title: Introduction and Background
items.summary: Host John Petrella introduced North Medford Ambassador Nate Rubright, who shared his background working in ministry at Grace Episcopal Church and contributing articles to Gotta Know Medford.

items.title: Role and Structure of the Ambassador Task Force
items.summary: Rubright explained that the ambassador role is an uncompensated volunteer position focused on being a resource for neighbors and helping them connect with local government services.

items.title: North Medford Community and Carr Park
items.summary: The discussion highlighted the renovated Carr Park as a key community gathering space and examined the need for hyper-local connections across North Medford neighborhoods.

items.title: Resident Outreach and Departmental Coordination
items.summary: Rubright detailed meeting monthly with city departments like Parking and Public Works to learn how to route resident questions effectively, noting he primarily communicates with neighbors via email.

items.title: Community Benefits and Program Outlook
items.summary: Rubright outlined how ambassadors assist residents with micro-level issues like block parties and park proposals, and Petrella concluded with show contact details.
